# Heritage Impact Assessment: Do I Need One, and What Does It Cost?

> Independent UK reference for Heritage Impact Assessments. Decide in four questions whether you need a full HIA, a Heritage Statement or nothing. 2026 fee bands £150 to £5,000+, NPPF citations...

## Framework currency note

On 17 August 2026 the Government published a revised National Planning Policy Framework. It restructured the historic environment chapter into thematic policies (HE1 to HE9) and retired the numbered heritage paragraphs and the term "less than substantial harm". Applicants now assess significance and the effect of a proposal under Policy HE5 on a five-point scale (positive effect, no effect, harm, substantial harm, total loss); harm to designated assets is weighed under Policy HE6 and non-designated assets under Policy HE7. Page entries below that cite numbered paragraphs (e.g. paragraph 200, 207, 208) or "less than substantial harm" describe the framework that applied until 16 August 2026 and are being updated. The current NPPF is at https://www.gov.uk/guidance/national-planning-policy-framework.
